# PARADA

> PARADA is a smart parking system for campuses and other sites with several parking areas. Ordinary cameras at each area's gates read plates and keep a live count, so drivers see where there is room before they arrive and staff see every area at a glance. Built and tested at Lyceum of the Philippines University — Batangas as a capstone project; a tested prototype, not yet installed at a parking site, and the team is ready to pilot it.

- [Home](https://parada.lorenzmalabanan.com/): What PARADA does, how it counts at the gates, what drivers and the office get, test results with their caveats, and how to contact the team about a pilot.
- [Demo](https://parada.lorenzmalabanan.com/demo/): A 3D model of the LPU-Batangas campus: one car's trip from the entrance camera to the exit receipt in nine stops, and a drive mode where the visitor drives it.
- [Technical overview](https://parada.lorenzmalabanan.com/technical/): Architecture, features, configuration, stack, security, and build status.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/E1yWrites/parada): Source code.
